# Blinded [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#BlindedCondition)*

While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects.

***Can't See.*** You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.

***Attacks Affected.*** Attack rolls against you have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md), and your attack rolls have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md).
